purpose: Machine-readable naming authority for active BuilderOS governance/runtime surfaces. Historical archives preserve original wording; active authority uses canonical names.

rules.notes: North Star §2.11b/§2.11c establishes Conductor as the current supervisory role. Legacy code identifiers containing chair may remain temporarily for compatibility but must not be presented as current governance terminology.
BuilderOS 1 is the original BuilderOS. Abbott is its nickname. It remains independent from BuilderOS 2 / Castello.

BuilderOS 2 is the second independent BuilderOS. Castello is its nickname. It is currently on ice and is not the present implementation focus. Historical or code references using Costello are legacy naming drift and should be migrated or flagged without changing archived evidence.
